scope: Wake the black guest display using the project's established single Shift pulse and verify release, current image, and unchanged emulator profile.

before.state: Black guest framebuffer with the persistent Apollo command legend visible.

wake.method: One-frame guest Shift pulse on :kbd:keyboard4/Shift; automatically cleared at frame 3; native guest screen snapshot at frame 65.
wake.visible: HP VUE desktop awake with Terminal and Trash Can; both scrollbar orientations visible.

limits: No mouse input, host focus change, emulator restart, profile change, or guest-file change.
This confirms wake and release only; it does not complete a held horizontal-arrow comparison.
next: Use the awake native reference for the remaining authorized GTK2 work. Do not repeat a mouse route unless a new method can visibly establish the cursor over the intended horizontal arrow before holding it.
